task.summary: Default task
Initial project setup.
Added loop to repeat through main menu until exit, validation to ensure operation choice is 1-4, added functions for each operation.
Created add_meal function to add meal to mealTracker dictionary.
Created add_workout function to add workout to workoutTracker dictionary. Updated some variable names in add_meal function.
Created search_date function to view meal and workout information for date searched. Added spaces and headers to outputs.
Created data validation module with function to validate integers, function to check if integer in range, and function to validate and convert string to date.
Input validation implemented in main.py, helper functions added to prompt user until valid input is entered.
Moved dictionaries to database module. Added functions to database module that add meal and workout entries to dictionaries.
Added functions to database module that return meal and workout data.
Created classes for Meal, Workout, and Day. Created methods for each class.

Modified health_data.py to work with objects. Created health_data dictionary to replace mealTracker and workoutTracker dictionaries. Updated add_meal and add_workout to work with objects, created get_entry() and add_day().
Created base class HealthEntry.
Created enumerations for types of meals and workouts.
Modified Meal and Workout to be subclasses of HealthEntry. Added meal type property to Meal, and workout type property to Workout.
Modified main.py by adding functions for getting meal type and workout type from user, added those inputs to the class calls for Meal and Workout.
Created package and files for unit tests. Created tests for functions in input_util.py.

Created tests for Meal and Workout objects. Modified HealthEntry calories setter to set default value if calories > 0. Modified Meal and Workout type setters to set default type if value is not correct Enum type.
Created tests for Day object.
Updated Resources documentation

Used copilot to generate function to create test data and added function to health_data.py. Updated main menu to include options to modify/delete meals and workouts. Created function to modify meal: search date, list meals found for date, and get user input to select meal to modify. Created function to modify attribute: get user input for which attribute to modify, then get user input for new attribute.
